repository_readme.source_command: mkdir -p out && go test ./tools/repositoryreadme -count=1 && go run ./tools/repositoryreadme -check-doc -evidence-out out/repository-readme-evidence.json
repository_readme.native_command: umask 077 && mkdir -p out && go test ./tools/repositoryreadme -count=1 && go run ./tools/repositoryreadme -check-doc -evidence-out out/repository-readme-evidence.json

classification.meaning: The repository README and executable-knowledge checks can run through pinned riido-ci with native redacted artifact evidence while the legacy workflow and runtime authority remain unchanged.
does_not_claim: the private repository CI policy currently passes

assertions: the repository-readme GitHub Actions workflow digest remains exact
all repository-readme job steps map to native riido-ci behavior with zero adapters
README and executable-knowledge evidence is redacted and mode 0600
the existing pinned central runner remains credential free
workflow retirement and runtime authority remain zero

loop.observation: The baseline Go workflow had native parity, but the repository entrypoint and executable-knowledge workflow remained one of fifty-five unmapped workflows.
loop.hypothesis: The existing credential-free runner can preserve the exact README and knowledge-coverage commands plus always-collected evidence without editing or retiring the legacy workflow.
loop.execute: Pin the repository-readme workflow digest, verify every native mapping, run both source checks under a restrictive umask and collect both evidence files as one redacted artifact boundary.
loop.evaluate: Require zero adapters, exact commands, mode-0600 outputs, passed central evidence and no workflow, Auth, AWS, runtime or fixed-cost authority.
loop.retrospective: Keep the source workflow byte-exact and count this as one bounded parity child only; retirement still requires a separate owner-reviewed blocked-to-passed policy pair.

dependency_allowlist.source_command: mkdir -p out && go run ./tools/dependencyallowlist -contract dependency_allowlist.riido.json -evidence-out out/dependency-allowlist-evidence.json

classification.meaning: The baseline Go job can run locally through pinned riido-ci with native artifact evidence, while the legacy workflow and all runtime authority remain unchanged.
does_not_claim: the private repository CI policy currently passes

assertions: the baseline GitHub Actions workflow digest remains exact
all baseline Go job steps map to native riido-ci behavior with zero adapters
the private local pipeline requires attestation and redacted evidence
the exact central runner revision is credential free
workflow retirement and runtime authority remain zero

loop.observation: The baseline Go workflow is natively convertible, but Control Plane did not own an exact parity receipt for the unchanged workflow.
loop.hypothesis: A source-owned contract and private attested riido-ci route can prove exact parity before any separate workflow retirement decision.
loop.execute: Verify the legacy digest, native step mapping, pinned credential-free runner and fail-closed artifact semantics, then run the full Go suite.
loop.evaluate: Require nine passing cases, zero adapters, mode-0600 evidence and no workflow, auth, AWS, runtime or fixed-cost authority.
loop.retrospective: Preserve the exact baseline and require a separate owner-reviewed blocked-to-passed policy pair before retirement.
